q: The Mean Ergodic Theorem (von Neumann) states that for a unitary operator U on a Hilbert space H, the averages N⁻¹ Σ_{n=0}^{N-1} Uⁿf converge:
opts: In L² norm to the projection of f onto the fixed-point subspace
Only for f in a dense subspace
Uniformly in f on the unit ball
exp: Von Neumann's mean ergodic theorem: the ergodic averages converge in the Hilbert space norm to Pf, where P is the orthogonal projection onto {f : Uf = f}.
